chapter: Benny Meroff and Chicago's jazz scene
title: Meroff the showman and the band's novelty instruments
summary: Meroff is a dancer and multi-instrumentalist; the band swaps to saxophones, violins, flutes or guitars, and Davison's guitar playing is compared with Sid Pritikin's.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: No - I must say that I have never worked for such a clever guy as Benny Meroff. He was probably one of the greatest showmen I have ever seen.
He wasn't that old either--- He was still in his twenties - wasn't he - when you first joined him.
I think he was older than me - I do think.
Well, he was older but I mean, I think maybe he was only six or eight years older--

Yeah but he was an absolutely sensational dancer; he could sing; he could play cello ; bass saxophone; flute; clarinet, and he get all these little tricks - you know - and he was a -- you know what a Russian dancer is ---
Yeah--
You know that's the most---
The Cossack thing - where they kick their feet out---
Yeah - he could do that so fast. And, he was a great, great showman -- now, some weeks he'd have us playing - the whole band would be playing saxophones ---
But, just for one number---
For one number--- and then, next time, we might be playing violins; the next time, all flutes; we just learned enough to ---
And, there's a great picture where you are all playing guitars---
Yeah and then, too, we all sang-- he'd turn us into a glee club--
You could actually play the guitar very well, couldn't you?
I didn't--- I never bothered with it anymore---
At that point though----
No - I quit that; I just never went back.
No, I mean at that point---
Oh, I knew I could--- well, I could do chords - anything---
You know, Sid Pritikon told me that you could play the guitar just about as well as he could and he was the band's guitar player---
Well, I could do single string stuff that Sid couldn't do. You know, a lot of -technical, jazzy
